text_en: Here is my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen, in whom my soul delights; I have put my spirit upon him; he will bring forth justice to the nations.
text_cn: 请看我扶持的仆人，我心灵喜爱的所选者！我在他身上倾注了我的神，叫他给万民传布真道。

text_en: He will not cry or lift up his voice, or make it heard in the street;
text_cn: 他不呼喊，不喧嚷，在街市上也听不到他的声音。

text_en: a bruised reed he will not break, and a dimly burning wick he will not quench; he will faithfully bring forth justice.
text_cn: 破伤的芦苇，他不折断；将熄的灯心，他不吹灭，他将忠实地传布真道。

text_en: He will not grow faint or be crushed until he has established justice in the earth; and the coastlands wait for his teaching.
text_cn: 他不沮丧，也不失望，直到他在世上奠定了真道，因为海岛都期待着他的教诲。

text_en: Thus says God, the Lord , who created the heavens and stretched them out, who spread out the earth and what comes from it, who gives breath to the people upon it and spirit to those who walk in it:
text_cn: 那创造且展布天空，铺张大地和布置大地的产物，给世人赐予气息，并给在地上行动的，赐与呼吸的天主上主这样说：

text_en: I am the Lord , I have called you in righteousness, I have taken you by the hand and kept you; I have given you as a covenant to the people, a light to the nations,
text_cn: “我，上主，因仁义召叫了你，我必提携你，保护你，立你作人民的盟约，万民的光明，

text_en: to open the eyes that are blind, to bring out the prisoners from the dungeon, from the prison those who sit in darkness.
text_cn: 为开启盲人的眼目，从狱中领出被囚的人，从牢里领出住在黑暗的人。

text_en: I am the Lord , that is my name; my glory I give to no other, nor my praise to idols.
text_cn: 我是上主，这是我的名字；我决不将我的光荣让与另一位，决不将我应受的赞美归于偶像。

text_en: See, the former things have come to pass, and new things I now declare; before they spring forth, I tell you of them.
text_cn: 先前的事，看，已经成就；我再宣告新近的事，在事未发生之前，我先告诉你们。”

text_en: Sing to the Lord a new song, his praise from the end of the earth! Let the sea roar and all that fills it, the coastlands and their inhabitants.
text_cn: 你们应向上主高唱新歌，称述他的荣耀直到地极！愿海洋和其中一切，愿岛屿和其上的居民赞美他！

text_en: Let the desert and its towns lift up their voice, the villages that Kedar inhabits; let the inhabitants of Sela sing for joy, let them shout from the tops of the mountains.
text_cn: 愿旷野和那里的城邑，刻达尔人所居住的村落欢呼！愿色拉的居民高声歌唱，从山顶上呐喊！

text_en: Let them give glory to the Lord , and declare his praise in the coastlands.
text_cn: 愿众人都归光荣于上主，在岛屿上称述他的荣耀！

text_en: The Lord goes forth like a soldier, like a warrior he stirs up his fury; he cries out, he shouts aloud, he shows himself mighty against his foes.
text_cn: 上主出征有如勇士，激起怒火有如战士；他要高喊呼叫，对自己的敌人显出他的英勇。

text_en: For a long time I have held my peace, I have kept still and restrained myself; now I will cry out like a woman in labor, I will gasp and pant.
text_cn: “我已缄默好久，安静自抑；然而现今我要像待产的妇女，呼喊、呻吟和哀叹。

text_en: I will lay waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbage; I will turn the rivers into islands, and dry up the pools.
text_cn: 我要使大山丘陵干透，使上边的草木枯槁；我要使河流化为旱地，使池沼涸(hé)竭(jié)。

text_en: I will lead the blind by a road they do not know, by paths they have not known I will guide them. I will turn the darkness before them into light, the rough places into level ground. These are the things I will do, and I will not forsake them.
text_cn: 我要领瞎子走他们不知道的路，带他们行不认识的道；使黑暗在他们前化为光明，使崎岖之途变为平坦：这些事我都要作，我决不放弃。

text_en: They shall be turned back and utterly put to shame— those who trust in carved images, who say to cast images, “You are our gods. ”
text_cn: 凡依赖偶像且向神像说：“你们是我们的神”的人，必要败退，蒙受奇辱。”

text_en: Listen, you that are deaf; and you that are blind, look up and see!
text_cn: 聋子，你们听！瞎子，你们睁眼看！

text_en: Who is blind but my servant, or deaf like my messenger whom I send? Who is blind like my dedicated one, or blind like the servant of the Lord ?
text_cn: 除了我的仆人外，谁还那么瞎呢？谁如同我派遣的人那么聋呢？谁像与我立和约的人那样瞎呢？谁似上主的仆人那样聋呢？

text_en: He sees many things, but does not observe them; his ears are open, but he does not hear.
text_cn: 他虽然看见了许多事，却一无所觉；耳朵开着，却没有听见。

text_en: The Lord was pleased, for the sake of his righteousness, to magnify his teaching and make it glorious.
text_cn: 上主为了自己的仁义，本来愿意把法律发扬广大，

text_en: But this is a people robbed and plundered, all of them are trapped in holes and hidden in prisons; they have become a prey with no one to rescue, a spoil with no one to say, “Restore! ”
text_cn: 但这民族遭受了洗劫和抢掠，被束缚于桎（zhì）梏（gù）之中，隐伏于监狱之内；他们成了抢掠之物，而无人搭救；受人劫夺，而无人敢说：“交出来！”

text_en: Who among you will give heed to this, who will attend and listen for the time to come?
text_cn: 你们中有谁静听这事，今后倾耳静听呢？

text_en: Who gave up Jacob to the spoiler, and Israel to the robbers? Was it not the Lord , against whom we have sinned, in whose ways they would not walk, and whose law they would not obey?
text_cn: 是谁把雅各伯交付给抢掠者？是谁将以色列交给了劫夺者？不是他们所得罪的，不肯行他的道路，不肯听从他的法律的那位上主吗？

text_en: So he poured upon him the heat of his anger and the fury of war; it set him on fire all around, but he did not understand; it burned him, but he did not take it to heart.
text_cn: 因此他在这民族身上发泄了自己的烈怒和战火；火已在她四周烧起，她仍不理会，已燃烧着她，她仍未放在心上。
